description:
Record an echo step in the flow named by `name` + `project_root`. Echo steps print a message when the flow is replayed — useful as labels between tool calls.
Use when you want to annotate a recorded flow with a human-readable label or checkpoint message.
Returns { message, stepCount, savedTo }. Fails if that flow has no recording in progress.

message.description: Message to echo when the flow is replayed

name.description: Name of the flow being recorded — the one passed to flow-start-recording.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the project root of the flow being recorded — the same value passed to flow-start-recording. Together with `name` it identifies which recording this echo belongs to.

name: flow-add-echo
